title: Quad pushups
instructions: Do 12 pushups on the Main Quad. Knee pushups count.
location_address: Main Quad, University of Illinois, Urbana, IL 61801
proof_prompt: Required video: show all 12 pushups.

title: Five catches
instructions: Grab a friend and make five frisbee catches at Hessel Park.
proof_prompt: Required video: show your five catches; short clips are fine.

title: Be a tree
instructions: Hold a tree pose for 20 seconds beside a tree at the UI Arboretum. Stay on an open path or lawn.
proof_prompt: Required video: show the full 20-second pose.

title: Tiny jog
instructions: Jog for five minutes on Crystal Lake Park’s paths.

title: Golden-hour stroll
instructions: Take a golden-hour walk at Meadowbrook Park. Leave by sunset.
proof_prompt: Required photo: take a selfie on the path with the evening sky behind you.

title: Become the blob
instructions: Make your body match the red-orange blob outside the IGB. Pose beside it with your feet on the ground.
location_name: Darwin’s Playground at the Institute for Genomic Biology

title: Basement bowling
